name: Nestlé
summary: Nestlé's jobs pages describe a recruitment journey of a CV screen, a first interview with a recruiter about your interests, experience and motivation, an interview with the hiring manager, and for some roles evaluations such as cognitive tests, a case study or a practical test, which Nestlé says it explains beforehand. A final interview may include meeting the team. Graduate programmes in some countries add online assessments, a video interview and an assessment centre.
rounds: First interview with a recruiter, often by phone or video, on motivation and experience
Interview with the hiring manager, online or in person
Evaluations for some roles: cognitive tests, a case study or a practical test
Final interview, sometimes meeting the team; for graduate programmes an assessment centre
Offer, often by phone first and then in writing
looks_for: Motivation for the role and for Nestlé
Achievements you can show with examples
Respect for people, cultures and the environment

questions.text: Tell me about an achievement you're proud of and how you got there.
covers: What you achieved and why it mattered
The result, with numbers if you have them

questions.text: Tell me about a time you worked with people from a different background or culture.
covers: How you adapted and built trust

questions.text: Tell me about a time a plan changed at the last minute.
Tell me about a time you improved a process to save time or waste.
How would you launch a new healthier version of a popular snack in a market that loves the original?
covers: Who it's for and why they'd switch
Measuring success without hurting the original

questions.text: A key supplier can't deliver an ingredient for two weeks. What do you do?
covers: Assessing stock and impact on production

questions.text: How would you reduce packaging waste for a product without raising its price much?
covers: Where the packaging is and what it does
Options and their cost and safety

questions.text: How would you decide which products to put on promotion in a supermarket this month?
covers: Goals: volume, new buyers or margin

questions.text: How do you make sure food quality and safety stay high when you're under pressure to deliver?
covers: An example if you have one

questions.text: What do you know about Nestlé's brands and what it stands for?
covers: Something about Nestlé's purpose or commitments

questions.text: Why do you want to work at Nestlé?
covers: Something specific about Nestlé that draws you
How your experience fits the role
What you hope to grow into

questions.text: Where do you see your career going in the next few years?
covers: A direction that fits the role

tips: Tailor your CV to the role: Nestlé's recruiters screen CVs against the job.
Prepare examples of teamwork, adaptability and achievements, using a clear structure such as STAR.
Nestlé says it explains any tests or case studies beforehand; ask your recruiter what to expect.
Nestlé says it only contacts candidates from official email addresses and never asks for payment.

sources.title: Nestlé: Start your Nestlé journey (recruitment process)
